scientific_integrity: The result is derived from explicit nine-state matrices; an independent vertex-level exhaustive test corroborates cases n=3..6. The unbounded claim rests on characteristic polynomials and a local proof, not on finite tests.
scientific_limitations: Only initially primitive three-periodic configurations on the stated gear graphs are counted; no result on all basins, all orbit periods, or full historical priority is asserted.
title: A cubic gear-wave law for immediate three-periodic excitation
